economy.summary: Her campaign says she is working every day to assure affordability for Monroe County families on groceries, gasoline, prescription drugs, and healthcare, and that she stands with unions and working people.
economy.short: Says she works for affordability; stands with unions, workers.

taxes.summary: Co-sponsored the 2023 law (HB 1100, Act 7 of 2023) that expanded Pennsylvania's Property Tax/Rent Rebate program, raising the maximum rebate and income eligibility limits for older homeowners and renters.
taxes.short: Co-sponsored 2023 Property Tax/Rent Rebate expansion law.

abortion.summary: Her campaign describes her as a steadfast defender of women's reproductive freedom, saying she will protect abortion access and IVF and keep fighting to get the government out of those decisions.
abortion.short: Says she will protect abortion access and IVF.

education.summary: Her campaign says she has worked to secure K-12 education funding across Pennsylvania and that every child in Monroe County deserves a fully funded school.
education.short: Says she secured K-12 funding; supports fully funded schools.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign says that as chairwoman of the House Aging & Older Adult Services Committee she leads the fight to increase elder care quality, protect Medicaid, and support caregivers.
healthcare.short: Says she works to protect Medicaid, elder care, caregivers.

energy.summary: Her campaign cites an 'A' rating from Conservation Voters of PA and a 'Friend of the Watershed' designation, saying protecting clean air, water, and the natural beauty of the Pocono Mountains is critical to her.
energy.short: Campaign cites conservation ratings; prioritizes clean air, water.

guns.summary: Endorsed in 2024 by CeaseFirePA Action, which backs candidates who support gun-safety policies including extreme risk protection orders and universal background checks; her campaign site does not detail a gun policy position.
guns.short: Endorsed by group backing background checks, extreme-risk orders.

economy.summary: His campaign says government should serve the people, not burden them, and pledges to empower small businesses and workers, opposing regulations he says burden enterprise so families can keep more of their earnings.
economy.short: Pledges to empower small businesses; opposes burdensome regulations.

taxes.summary: His campaign pledges to fight for lower taxes, predictable regulations, and responsible spending.
taxes.short: Pledges lower taxes, predictable regulations, responsible spending.

education.summary: Says parents should have a real voice in what their children are being taught, and that schools should emphasize academic fundamentals, practical life skills, and expanded career and technical education, while supporting teachers.
education.short: Supports parental voice, academic fundamentals, career-technical education, teachers.

energy.summary: Says environmental policy should be practical and balanced, supporting responsible stewardship that protects clean water while respecting property rights and local jobs; opposes rushed approvals of data centers, warehouse expansion, and large-scale solar projects without full impact reviews and stronger public notice.
energy.short: Supports clean-water stewardship; opposes rushed data-center, solar approvals.

guns.summary: His campaign lists protecting constitutional rights and supporting law enforcement among his commitments; the site does not detail a specific gun policy.
guns.short: Pledges to protect constitutional rights, support law enforcement.
